title: LevelBorderModern
description: A modern Minecraft Paper plugin for 1.21+ where the world border grows as players gain XP levels.
body:
LevelBorderModern is a lightweight and configurable Paper plugin for Minecraft 1.21+ that automatically expands the world border whenever players gain XP levels. Every new level increases the border size, creating a unique progression-based survival experience where exploration unlocks over time. Perfect for SMPs, hardcore challenges, and custom survival gameplay. Includes commands for managing, resetting, reloading, and manually setting the world border. Requires Paper 1.21+ and Java 21.

**Commands:**
/levelborder status
/levelborder reset
/levelborder reload
/levelborder set <size>
